default.flash.gate.title: Web Serial API Required
default.flash.gate.subtitle: Flash your Meshtastic device using Chrome or Edge
default.flash.gate.caveat: Firefox and Safari do not support Web Serial
default.flash.picker.notFoundBody: Can't find your device? It may not be ESP32-based or not supported by Meshtastic.
default.flash.connect.readyHint: Plug in USB, then click Connect
default.flash.connect.readyHintDfu: Double-tap RESET on the device, then click Connect
default.flash.error.inUse.esp32: The serial port is in use by another program (Arduino IDE, PlatformIO, or another browser tab running the flasher). Close it and try again.
default.flash.error.inUse.nrf52: The DFU interface is in use by another program (nrfutil, uf2conv, or another browser tab running the flasher). Close it and try again.
default.flash.error.noResponse.esp32: Couldn't reach the device. Try a different data USB cable (some are charge-only), or put the device in bootloader mode using the steps below.
default.flash.error.noResponse.nrf52: Couldn't reach the device. Try a different data USB cable (some are charge-only), or put the device in bootloader mode (double-tap RESET) using the steps below.
default.flash.error.generic.esp32: Serial connection failed. Try the troubleshooting steps below.
default.flash.error.generic.nrf52: DFU connection failed. Try the troubleshooting steps below.
default.flash.help.esp32.title: Serial connect failed? Try these
default.flash.help.nrf52.title: DFU connect failed? Try these
default.flash.flash.eraseWarning: This will erase all existing firmware and data on the device
default.flash.flash.keepConnected: Keep your USB cable connected during the flash process
default.flash.flash.doNotDisconnect: Do not disconnect your device during flash
default.flash.flash.recovery1: Don't panic — your device can be re-flashed
default.flash.flash.recovery2: Reconnect the USB cable if it was disconnected
default.flash.flash.recovery4: Click Retry to start over with a fresh connection
default.flash.nrf52.title: Flash firmware (drag & drop)
default.flash.nrf52.continue: I've flashed it — Continue to Configure
default.flash.configure.connectBody: Your device should now be running Meshtastic after the firmware copy. Click below and pick it from the browser's serial-port prompt to configure it for the DEF CON 34 mesh and register it to your account.
default.flash.configure.reconnectingBody: Your device is rebooting after firmware flash. This may take a few seconds.
default.flash.configure.selectPortBody: A browser prompt will ask which serial port to use — pick your device (it appears as a USB serial port now that it's running Meshtastic).
default.flash.configure.doNotDisconnect: Do not disconnect your device during configuration
default.flash.configure.completeBody: Your device has been configured for the DEF CON 34 mesh network.
default.flash.configure.recovery1: Don't panic — your firmware is still intact
default.flash.configure.recovery2: Make sure your USB cable is still connected
default.flash.configure.recovery3: Click Retry to reconnect and try configuration again
default.flash.done.title: Setup Complete!
default.flash.done.subtitle: Your device is configured and ready for the DEF CON 34 mesh network.
default.flash.done.configuredFallback: Your device has been successfully configured.
default.flash.done.regFailedHint: You can manually add the radio on run.defcon.run
default.flash.done.step1Desc: Link your device to your DEF CON 34 profile
default.flash.done.step2: Download the Meshtastic app to monitor your device
default.flash.done.step3: Disconnect USB — your device is ready!
default.flash.done.step3Desc: Your radio will automatically join the mesh network
